understanding: The supplied source establishes candidate-local campaign dispatch, result tallying, self-vote handling, and sequential vote-storage calls. Pre-vote can precede an election, while disabled pre-vote and leadership transfer bypass it. This delta maps those synchronous responsibilities and retains a separate frontier for asynchronous response semantics and unresolved transition helpers.

behaviors.protocol_context: One runCandidate invocation while local state remains Candidate.
implementation_guards: Pre-vote runs only when preVoteDisabled is false and candidateFromLeadershipTransfer is false.
The loop continues while getState() returns Candidate.
Pre-vote responses above the invocation's initially computed next term request follower transition and term update.
Vote responses above getCurrentTerm() request follower transition and term update.
writes: Election timer and active campaign channels.
candidateFromLeadershipTransfer is reset by a deferred store.
durable_effects: Invokes setCurrentTerm on a higher-term response; its implementation and durability semantics are not supplied.
external_effects: Rejects configuration changes, apply, verify, restore, and leadership-transfer requests with ErrNotLeader.
Returns a cloned configuration on configurationsCh and ErrCantBootstrap on bootstrapCh.
Calls setState(Leader) and setLeader after the granted-vote threshold is reached.
important_branches: A successful pre-vote tally disables prevoteCh, resets the election timer, and invokes electSelf.
A refused pre-vote threshold only logs failure; the loop continues until another selected event.
Granted vote results increment a scalar count; this loop does not deduplicate voterID or explicitly reject lower-term grants.
Election timeout returns; restart depends on the caller, whose implementation is not attached.
Follower notification refreshes the timer only if ElectionTimeout changed.
async_boundaries: select receives RPCs, campaign results, client requests, notifications, timeout, and shutdown.
Remote result establishment occurs in separate goroutines.

cross_activity_effects.value: Candidate-side handling rejects the listed leader-only requests with ErrNotLeader.
Candidate-side handling rejects configuration changes and serves a cloned configuration through configurationsCh.

existing_protections: Campaign response channels are obtained separately for each invocation.
Higher-term responses cause an early return after transition-helper calls.
The leadership-transfer flag is reset on exit.
An election timeout bounds waiting in the candidate loop.
unknowns: quorumSize, setState, setLeader, setCurrentTerm, and processRPC implementations are not attached.
Remote response validity, transport identity correlation, and configuration uniqueness are not established by the scalar tally.
Leader transition completion and subsequent leader initialization are not established by the observed call sites.

Remote goroutines scheduled before a local persistence error are not cancelled here.

Local results are enqueued for later candidate-loop consumption.

surfaces.entry_point: runCandidate / electSelf / preElectSelf: synchronous campaign control and local votes
surfaces.reason: Attached implementations support local dispatch, tally branches, self-result publication, client handling, and the sequential persistence helper. Mapping does not resolve called transition helpers or remote response guarantees.

surfaces.entry_point: electSelf / preElectSelf: remote response production and transition-helper semantics
surfaces.reason: Separately interpret remote goroutine results, including RequestVote error-to-refusal conversion and RequestPreVote unsupported-command error-to-grant conversion. Resolve transport correlation and the quorumSize, setCurrentTerm, setState, and setLeader declarations before asserting stronger support, durability, or completed-transition facts. The remote callback bodies are already attached; helper implementations require focused reading.

delta.rationale: Replace the composite deferred surface with a sourced synchronous mapping and an explicit remaining frontier. Separate campaign control, election dispatch, pre-vote dispatch, and vote storage. Facts describe API completion and channel publication without converting them into durable vote validity or completed leadership. No global Activity or TargetProfile changes are justified by this focused packet.

limitations: Remote response producers are intentionally not represented as fact producers in this delta; their actor-level interpretation remains deferred.
Transition-helper call sites do not establish completed role changes or durable term updates.
Stable-store semantics, configuration validation, receiver-side voting rules, and transport correlation remain unresolved.
No normative obligation, defect, calibration result, or overall correctness conclusion is derived.
